page.layout: One handwritten column of entries, each with a page number, running down the left-hand part of the scan. No printed text.
page.notes: The page carries a manuscript list of virtues and vices with page numbers (roughly 20 to 334), written in ink by hand. It is not printed, so it is left out of the transcription. Some entries are doubtful, marked [?] in the separate list below: "Vitaburnaa" and the entry at 172 are unclear. The list appears to be a reader's or owner's annotation added to the book.
